visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with two pigtails, wearing a yellow daisy-print dress, stands at a wooden table covered with numerous circular animal cards. She uses her hands to sort and pick up the cards. An adult's hands occasionally enter from the left side to help or receive cards. (2) The toddler searches the array of cards, picking up a polar bear illustration and showing it to the adult. The background is a brightly lit playroom with white storage shelves filled with toy bins and soft plush toys. (3) The girl focuses on the table, pointing to different animal graphics. She picks up a panda card, pauses to examine it, then puts it aside to find an elephant card. (4) She begins rhythmic mouth movements and gestures as if performing, looking directly at the adult. She picks up a monkey card and mimics a specific posture with her hands. (5) She leans over the table to reach cards further away, then holds a sea lion card close to her face. (6) The video cuts to a solid pink screen with a central cartoon avatar of the girl and brand text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A soft female adult voice speaks in Traditional Chinese, guiding a child through a game. Low-frequency tapping sounds occur as objects hit a wooden surface. (2) A toddler's voice responds with high pitch and bright valence, identifying animals. The adult provides high-energy verbal reinforcement. (3) The child begins singing a melodic nursery rhyme in a natural, clear voice. The pitch variability is high and playful. (4) The child performs a vocal imitation of a monkey with sharp, staccato vocal bursts. (5) A short, high-tempo electronic jingle with a major key signature plays as the segment concludes.
